name: print-social-mint-and-lilac-marketing-studio-poster-with-tilted-strategy-pills-and-bulb
title: Marketing Studio Poster with Tilted Strategy Pills
whatItIs: A square poster template with a ruled frame, a strip at the top of tilted lilac and mint pills reading MarketingStrategy, a heavy black 'Marketing Studio.' headline, a line-art smiling lightbulb, small social icons and a scrolling ticker of the same words along the base with a lilac-to-mint wash.
whatItMeans: Tilted pills scattered like stickers and a hand-drawn bulb keep a marketing message friendly and light.
techniques: Pills scattered at different angles as stickers
Heavy headline against fine ruled frame
Ticker strip with arrow icons at the base
Soft pastel gradient wash in the corners

vocabulary.definition: A rounded label placed at an angle like a sticker.
A repeating band of words with arrows.
A simple outlined drawing with a face used as a character.
